title: 第9章 谁家妖怪去偷一件破袈裟啊第10章 把仙丹当饭吃
slug: 西游开局获得太白金星传承
lines: 怀着这种震动，老猴妖随即离开，召集群妖往流沙河而去。
叶云则是取出了得自猴哥的天材地宝。
之前他只是炼化了其中一小株而已，还剩下不少大货呢。
“这些应该能增加不少进度点，按照十二万进度点划分，每达到三万，就能提升一个小境界……”
叶云觉得，有猴哥的这些天材地宝，加上流沙河里的，不说让他突破一个大境界。
但突破两三个小境界，还是轻轻松松的。
“到时候我再把那三道神通的进度给提一提，搞到精通层次。”
“然后就去黑风山附近，去找找那凌虚子，看看能不能弄来炼丹之法。”
这是叶云近期的目标。
唯一要在意的是，那黑风山此时有没有那黑熊怪。
说起那黑熊怪，也不是等闲之辈。
竟能与取经后的猴哥斗上不少回合，足以说明其实力不俗。
不过有一说一，那黑熊怪一看就不是野生的妖怪。
不仅实力不俗，还喜欢讲道参禅，高谈阔论，精于文墨。
最重要的是，知晓不少玄妙法门，比如传给观音禅院金池长老服气延寿之法，令其活了将近三百年。
这无论怎么看，都是有身世背景的。
参考观音菩萨最终将其收归麾下，成为珞珈山守山大神。
很明显，这黑熊怪本来就跟观音关系不浅，于是便令其化为一劫，然后顺理成章的收入麾下。
这一点，从黑熊精放着唐僧不要，去偷一件袈裟也能看出来。
谁家妖怪去偷一件破袈裟啊！
所以，此时黑风山不一定有黑熊怪。
“到时候远距离暗中观察一下，如果在的话，那就暂时退去，日后强大再来。”
“如果没在，那就万事大吉。”
叶云心中默语，显得小心谨慎。
由不得他不小心，毕竟这可是西游世界，大佬那么多。
凡事不说谋定而后动，至少也是要想好退路的。
在没有足够的实力前，还是要多注意一些。
随后，叶云以法力将这些天材地宝压缩成灵液，一一吞服，配合周围的灵气，开始苦修。
与此同时。
老猴妖已然带着群妖来到了流沙河。
因为他们的实力相比之前提升了很多，所以在水里也能自由行动，不受束缚。
当然，也仅限于行动，要是争斗，那肯定是做不到。
此刻。
老猴妖按照叶云的吩咐，让群妖，以及流沙河里的土著妖怪们，在流沙河底搜寻天材地宝。
流沙河虽说不是什么名川大河，钟灵毓秀之地。
但也是一奇观，经过多年沉淀，还是有不少好东西的，比黄风岭还强。
毕竟黄风岭的天材地宝，也有部分是之前妖怪采摘过的。
而流沙河因为规模和水势的缘故，少有妖怪探索完的，所以还是很有存货的。
就这么一会儿，已经收获了不少了。
群妖脸上都洋溢着笑容，有了这些天材地宝，大王又会狠狠的奖励他们了！
老猴妖也亲自动手，干的比谁都卖力。
至于流沙河的本土妖怪，在从老猴妖他们那里听说了，真的会有奖励后，一个个也动力满满。
于是，多年未被开发的流沙河，就这么迎来了群妖的开荒。
日后沙僧被贬到此地，面对的怕是一片已经完全被榨干的流沙河了。
content_en:
With this shock, the old monkey demon immediately left and gathered the group of demons to go to Liusha River.
Ye Yun took out the treasures of heaven and earth obtained from Brother Monkey.
He had only refined a small part of it before, and there was still a lot of big stuff left.
"These should be able to increase a lot of progress points. According to the 120,000 progress points, every time it reaches 30,000, it can increase a small level..."
Ye Yun felt that with Brother Monkey's natural and earthly treasures, plus those from Liusha River, he would be able to reach a great level.
But it is still easy to break through two or three small realms.
"At that time, I will mention the progress of those three magical powers and get them to the level of mastery."
"Then we will go to the Black Wind Mountain area to find Ling Xuzi and see if we can get the alchemy method."
This is Ye Yun's recent goal.
The only thing to care about is whether there is a black bear monster in Black Wind Mountain at this time.
Speaking of the black bear monster, he is no ordinary person.
To be able to fight many rounds with Brother Monkey after he learned the scriptures is enough to show that he is very powerful.
But there is one thing to say, the black bear monster is not a wild monster at first glance.
Not only is he very capable, he also likes to preach and practice Zen, talk eloquently, and is good at writing.
The most important thing is that he knows many mysterious methods, such as the method of subduing Qi and extending life passed to Elder Jinchi of Guanyin Temple, which allowed him to live for nearly three hundred years.
No matter how you look at it, it all has a background.
Referring to Guanyin Bodhisattva, he finally took him under his command and became the guardian god of Luojia Mountain.
Obviously, this black bear monster had a close relationship with Guanyin, so he made it a disaster and then naturally took it under his command.
This can be seen from the fact that the black bear spirit left Tang Monk behind and stole a cassock.
Whose monster is going to steal a tattered cassock!
Therefore, there may not necessarily be a black bear monster in Black Wind Mountain at this time.
"When the time comes, observe it secretly from a distance. If it is there, retreat temporarily and come back stronger in the future."
"If he wasn't here, then everything would be fine."
Ye Yun whispered in his heart, appearing cautious.
He couldn't help but be careless, after all, this was the world of Journey to the West, and there were so many big bosses.
Rather than making a decision before taking action, you must at least think of a way out.
Before you have enough strength, you still need to pay more attention.
Later, Ye Yun used his magic power to compress these heavenly materials and earthly treasures into spiritual liquid, swallowed them one by one, and began to practice hard in conjunction with the surrounding spiritual energy.
……
at the same time.
The old monkey demon has already led the group of demons to the Liusha River.
Because their strength has improved a lot compared to before, they can move freely in the water without being restrained.
Of course, it is limited to actions. If it is a fight, it will definitely not be possible.
now.
The old monkey demon followed Ye Yun's instructions and asked the group of demons and the indigenous monsters in the Liusha River to search for heavenly materials and earthly treasures at the bottom of the Liusha River.
Although Liusha River is not a famous river, it is a beautiful place.
But it is also a wonder. After years of accumulation, there are still many good things, even better than Huangfengling.
After all, some of the natural treasures in Huangfengling were picked by monsters before.
Due to its size and water potential, few monsters have fully explored the Liusha River, so it is still quite stocked.
In just a short time, I have gained a lot.
The faces of the demons are all filled with smiles. With these natural and earthly treasures, the king will reward them severely again!
The old monkey demon also took matters into his own hands and worked harder than anyone else.
As for the local monsters in Liusha River, after hearing from the old monkey monster and the others that there would be rewards, all of them became very motivated.
As a result, the Liusha River, which had not been developed for many years, was ushered in by a group of monsters.
In the future, when Sha Monk is demoted to this place, he may face a river of quicksand that has been completely drained.
